options.title: AI Malware Filter
options.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Blocks malicious domains using machine learning.

options.title: Safe Search
options.description: Prevent search engines from showing mature content.

options.title: Restricted Youtube
options.description: Prevent Youtube from showing mature content and disable comments.

options.title: DNS Rebind Protection
options.description: Blocks domains that point to RFC1918 addresses.

options.title: Disable DNSSEC
options.description: Turn off DNSSEC validation and ECS support for compatibility.

options.title: Block TTL
options.description: DNS record TTL (in seconds) when blocking.

options.title: Redirect TTL
options.description: DNS record TTL (in seconds) when redirecting.

options.title: Bypass TTL
options.description: DNS record TTL (in seconds) when bypassing.

options.title: Block Response
options.description: Choose how to respond to blocked queries.

options.title: EDNS Client Subnet
options.description: Override the EDNS Client Subnet for this profile.

options.title: Compatibility Mode
options.description: Cross-stack compatibility mode for IPv6 enabled networks. Don't blindly enable this.

options.title: Enable DNS64
options.description: Enables DNS64 on NAT64 supporting IPv6-only networks. Don't blindly enable this.

options.title: CNAME Flattening
options.description: Flatten CNAME records to their target IP addresses.
